description: Edit a room the account owns or administers: its name, icon, colour, description, whether every member may send, and the per-member cooldown. Only the fields you send change. Members see a short system Ping for a rename, a new icon or a new description, and their devices refresh. A room's public identity (visibility, @handle, category, location, owner display) is not editable here. Answers with the updated room.

color.description: Hex color, e.g. "#e33122". Any hue that stays visible on both a white and a near-black background; the room's current colour always passes.

cooldown_seconds.description: Seconds a member waits between Pings in this room (0 to 5).

description.description: Short room description. An empty string clears it.

everyone_can_trigger.description: Whether every member may send the room's Pings (true) or only the owner and admins (false).

icon.description: A v3 room-icon catalog id, e.g. "bell" (list_room_icons), or the room's current icon unchanged.

name: update_room

result.description: Purpose-built PingRoom result with credential and account fields removed.

title: Update Room
